description:
1. Disable unnecessary actuator endpoints by setting management.endpoints.web.exposure.exclude=health,info in application.properties
2. If endpoints are required, implement proper authentication using Spring Security
3. Restrict access to actuator endpoints to trusted IP addresses or networks only

example.after:
management.endpoints.web.exposure.exclude=health,info
# OR if needed, secure with authentication:
management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=health,info
management.endpoint.health.show-details=when-authorized
